claim: For the Liu–Tan memory-based prey-taxis predator–prey system, the paper’s own linearization of the taxis term implies that every nonzero Neumann mode \(k\) has characteristic equation \[\lambda^2+P_k\lambda+Q_k+S_k e^{-\lambda\tau}=0,\qquad S_k=-a_{12}\chi v_*\mu_k>0,\] not source Eqs. (4.5)–(4.6) with \(R_k=a_{12}\chi v_*\mu_k<0\). Because the frequency equation depends only on \(S_k^2\), the source’s candidate Hopf frequencies remain unchanged. However, whenever \(P_k>0\) and \(\omega_k>0\) is such a candidate frequency, the true critical-delay family is \[\tau_{k,j}=\frac{2j\pi+\arccos((\omega_k^2-Q_k)/S_k)}{\omega_k},\qquad j=0,1,2,\ldots,\] whereas the printed formula (4.18) equals \(\tau_{k,j}+\pi/\omega_k\). Thus the analytical delay locations in (4.18), the minimum delay threshold built from them in (4.21), and Hopf calculations anchored to those printed locations are phase-mislocated by exactly half a period. The zero-delay determinant formula (4.9) already uses the correct sign. This claim is a local spectral correction; it does not by itself invalidate the reported nonlinear simulations or classify their long-time dynamics.
integrity: The full Liu–Tan text was inspected through its open-access article and CC-BY full text, including the linearization, characteristic equation, zero-delay determinant, delay-phase formula, and Hopf theorem.
The earlier Song–Peng–Zhang full text was inspected at the corresponding memory-diffusion determinant formula and gives the same corrected sign structure.
No published correction or erratum was found in exact-title, DOI, and sign-alias searches as of the review date.
scientific_limitations: The correction is to the local modal characteristic equation and the delay phase; the squared frequency equation is unchanged.
The nonlinear simulations and normal-form coefficients were not independently recomputed, so they are not declared false by this finding alone.
The claim applies to nonzero Neumann modes with positive taxis sensitivity and a positive coexistence predator density; the zero mode has no taxis-delay term.
title: Memory-taxis Hopf delays are shifted by half a period
